svg.title: The 1956 Suez Crisis and Sinai Campaign (October–November 1956)
svg.desc: Pearson Edexcel GCSE History cartographic map showing Gamal Abdel Nasser's July 1956 nationalisation of the Suez Canal, the Gaza Strip border flashpoint, Israel's 29 October 1956 Mitla Pass paratroop drop and Sinai thrusts to Sharm el-Sheikh, the Anglo-French landings at Port Said on 5–6 November 1956, and the reopening of the Straits of Tiran with UNEF peacekeepers.

g.text: Secret Sèvres Plan: UK & French troops
seize Port Said; halted by US financial
blocked with sunken ships in Nov.
shipping to Eilat guaranteed by UNEF
